name: The Great Tree Provides

angles.text: The herbal remedies of Teldrassil reflect the kaldorei belief that their world tree sustains and protects them, offering living medicine against sudden afflictions.
Druids appreciate the natural restorative properties found within Teldrassil's flora, relying on native plants like lasher fronds rather than artificial concoctions.
Gathering native plant materials like dewy lasher fronds to brew potent healing salves is second nature to practiced herbalists.

aliases: what is the great tree provides
faq.answer: The Great Tree Provides is an urgent task in Dolanaar given by Byancie, who seeks to concoct a restorative salve to halt an affliction threatening Eralya until further treatment is possible.
faq.q: What is The Great Tree Provides?

faq.answer: Byancie is a night elf healer or apothecary residing in the village of Dolanaar on Teldrassil, dedicated to tending to the sick and preparing natural remedies from the local flora.

Eralya is an afflicted individual currently outside Dolanaar whose condition is rapidly deteriorating. Byancie needs an emergency salve to stabilize her long enough to bring her safely into town for full treatment.
faq.q: Who is Eralya and what happened to her?

aliases: where to find dewy lasher fronds
faq.answer: Dewy lasher fronds grow on plant lashers surrounding Lake Al'Ameth directly south of Dolanaar, as well as along Wellspring Lake and its river to the northwest.
faq.q: Where are dewy lasher fronds found?

faq.answer: Byancie requires six dewy lasher fronds harvested from native lashers, an empty vial, and refreshing spring water to mix the emergency healing salve.
faq.q: What ingredients are required to prepare the salve?

aliases: where do you get vial and spring water
faq.answer: Both empty vials and refreshing spring water can be purchased directly from general or trade supplies vendors stationed in the settlement of Dolanaar.
faq.q: Where can you obtain an empty vial and refreshing spring water?

sections.body: In the forested village of Dolanaar, Byancie tends to the well-being of the local night elves. When news arrives that Eralya has fallen victim to a dangerous affliction out in the wilds of Teldrassil, Byancie immediately sets to work preparing an emergency treatment. Without a quick-acting salve to halt the progression of the ailment, Eralya will not survive the journey back to the village for formal care.
sections.title: A Race Against Time

sections.body: Even in moments of crisis, the kaldorei put their trust in the bounty of Teldrassil. Byancie turns to the living world tree for the cure, seeking dewy lasher fronds known to flourish near Lake Al'Ameth to the south and Wellspring Lake to the northwest. Blended with clean spring water in a simple glass vial, these potent leaves provide the vital medicine needed to hold the affliction at bay.
sections.title: The Bountiful World Tree

summary: The Great Tree Provides is a quest in Dolanaar where Byancie enlists aid to halt a dangerous affliction threatening Eralya. By harvesting dewy lasher fronds from Teldrassil's lakes and gathering basic supplies, players help prepare an urgent restorative salve.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Great Tree Provides
